steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add one CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for the RFQ.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes set to None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the configured terms.

steps.note: Configure the two optional event clauses, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA vendor participant for the vendor-side submission.
Publish the RFQ after all required setup is complete.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited QA vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Enter a quote of 100 for the line and submit it; the vendor flow handles accepting the available optional terms before submission.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer session to inspect the event after vendor submission.
Confirm the first configured clause is visible on the buyer side.
Confirm the second configured clause is visible on the buyer side.
